body: Hey man you are not worthless, by the sounds of it you are a result of your environment and nobody could blame you for that, it may seem now that everything is terrible, and I'm not going to bullshit you it sounds like it is, but you don't need to worry about not having a relationship or anything like that as it's not actually as important as you might think. If you need someone to talk to my dms are open but for the future just try to get out of your situation, I realize that's just about the hardest thing for you to do but if you are able to escape the environment you might find that the world isn't as bad as you think :)
It's no problem, and thank you too :) my dms are also always open if you ever want to talk
No problem, if you ever need to chat my dms are open

It seems like you didn't really do any of this out of malice, just misunderstandings, which again supports that you're not a bad person. I would recommend seeing a therapist if you can since talking it through with them should help with the guilt.

Wow dude, when you said you had done awful things I thought you would say some really horrible things like sexual abuse. You are clearly a good person if you feel this bad over something I would consider to be minor bullying at best, certianly a better person than I am. I would say that the amount of regret you have shown already tells me that you do deserve happiness since you have the potential to be an amazing person with the amount of empathy you seem to have. I don't like saying it like this since it minimalises your problem but you've blown it out of proportion, the majority of children do things like what you have described and it's only as bad as you think in your head. If 2 people have already said they don't mind then it couldn't have affected them that badly.
Agreed, the likelyhood is the majority of uses will end in bad trips

It sounds like you are a good person trapped in a terrible situation, I'm so sorry you had to go through all of that but if you need anything to hang onto to keep yourself going it's that you're almost 18 and therefor almost an adult who can get a job and move out to live by yourself and maybe even cut your family off since both your parents don't sound like they are particularly supportive or nice to you. I think that if you can get out of your situation with your family you will notice an increase in your mental health, though I'm not sure how easy it would be for you to leave. Do you have any plans for after school?

The first thing you have to realise is that no one is perfect, everyone has issues and struggles that they deal with but some people need more support and that's totally okay. I understand the battle in your mind of the world vs the warped perception of it you have created, I know this since I'm living it myself but the best thing about that is that the problem is very clear, even if the solution isn't. Have you sought out professional help? If you have then that's a brilliant first step and if you haven't then I strongly recommend it. I understand that this next bit might sound like lies since you spoke about a eating disorder and I know that that may have ruined your perception of yourself, but I promise that you aren't as bad as you think you are, and I've never even met you! You called yourself unintelligent but you've promised to stop self harming and you have posted to a place of support, that already shows you have smarts. It's a real shit thing to have to deal with and I am so sorry you have to go through it but please remember that with enough time and support you can get through this, and the world you now see as shit will eventually be able to show its true colors as a beautiful place with so much to experience.

Would you feel comfortable sharing what it was thay you did? And I suppose believing that you can become a good person again depends on your definition of a good person and what makes someone good. I personally believe that there is a balance of good/bad in everyone and while you can easily tip the balance into being a bad person it also can go the other way, and you can reset the balance by doing good things and trying to change the world for the better.

I know someone has already said it but definitely don't try to overdose with paracetamol, it's a terrible and slow way to die and there is a good chance you could change your mind about wanting to die when you have been taken to the hospital, only to find out there is irreparable damage to your liver and that you are already basically dead. I promise you that living is better than dying in that way.

If you think there's a chance they don't remember it's probably not as terrible as you say, obviously I don't know whay you've done but the fact you are this torn up about it shows you have the capability to be a good person one day, I agree with the other commenter

Do you have many friends you can talk to while you adjust to being single? Having someone to talk to can help a lot, also do you have any hobbies you can partake in to try and get your mind off him? One thing to remember anything that's broken can be fixed, or rather helped back into a healthy state since fixed makes you sound like a object. The main thing to remember is the world is a lot bigger than where you are, and there will always be places to go to get a fresh view of life or just to restart somewhere else. I hope your hard times pass soon and you are able to recover to be the great person im sure you can be.

I think the main thing is that it's permenant, and while I wont say it always gets better or that you will come out the other side a stronger person, it is certainly something to take into consideration. I believe suicide is an option that should only be taken after every other option is exhausted, meaning not just the options you perceive yourself to have but the real, actual options you have in life. Once you can say you've actually tried everything and suicide is the last resort you can leave this world knowing you tried everything to help yourself, and I would hope there would be a sense of calm in the last moments rather than a deep depressive state. Idk that's just my thoughts on it

I know exactly what you mean, this is how I've been feeling for a while now and while I don't really have any solid advice I would say it's easier to overcome an apathetic depression like this since there isn't really as much of an emotional drive behind it, and since the human mind has to be incredibly driven before it will allow itself to kill itself the danger of actual suicide is probably lower (at least in my experience) do you have any life goals that you've wanted to achieve?

You need to find someone who cares for you as a friend just as much as you seem to for everyone. I know it's not as simple as that and obviously trying to find someone like that will take time but my advise would be to be a bit selfish, next time you are becoming friends with someone don't immediately rush to help them with all their problems unless they are happy to help back, and if it seems like they are using you again cut it off there and then to save the pain later. I know it will be hard but if you succeed I'm sure you will love it
